relationships.subject: CGRP(R) monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: The efficacy of CGRP(R) mAbs to reduce migraine days does not differ from topiramate.

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: erenumab 140 mg (p = 0.04) and galcanezumab 120 mg (p = 0.02) and 240 mg (p = 0.04) are superior to topiramate 50 mg

key_findings: Indirect meta-analysis of 13 trials: CGRP(R) mAbs and topiramate have similar efficacy for episodic migraine prophylaxis but mAbs have better safety (LLH 24.3:1 vs 1.8:1).
